title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Retroactive Effect of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China and the Scope of Cases Accepted by the Compensation Committees of People's Courts

articles.content_en: 1. In accordance with the provisions of Article 35 of the State Compensation Law, the State Compensation Law shall come into force as of January 1, 1995. The State Compensation Law shall not have retroactive effect. That is: acts committed by State organs and their staff when exercising their functions and powers that infringe upon the lawful rights and interests of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations which occurred before December 31, 1994, shall be handled in accordance with the relevant provisions then in force. Those which occurred on or after January 1, 1995 and are confirmed according to law shall be subject to compensation under the State Compensation Law. For acts which occurred before December 31, 1994 but continued until on or after January 1, 1995, and are confirmed according to law, the part that shall be compensated for the period on or after January 1, 1995 shall be compensated under the State Compensation Law; the part that shall be compensated for the period before December 31, 1994 shall be compensated in accordance with the provisions then in force; where there were no provisions at that time, compensation shall be provided by reference to the provisions of the State Compensation Law.

2. In accordance with the relevant provisions of the State Compensation Law, the Compensation Committee of the People's Court shall accept the following cases:
1. Where an organ exercising the powers of investigation, prosecution, or prison administration, or its staff, when exercising its functions and powers, infringes upon the personal rights or property rights of a citizen, legal person, or other organization, causing damage, and such act is confirmed according to law as subject to compensation, and the claimant for compensation, after applying for compensation and applying for reconsideration according to law, due to dissatisfaction with the reconsideration decision or because the reconsideration organ fails to make a decision within the time limit, applies to the Compensation Committee of the People's Court at the same level as the location of the reconsideration organ within the statutory time limit for a decision on compensation;
2. Where the People's Court is the organ liable for compensation, and the claimant for compensation, after applying for compensation, because the organ liable for compensation fails to make compensation within the time limit or the claimant disputes the amount of compensation, applies to the Compensation Committee of the People's Court at the next higher level than the organ liable for compensation within the statutory time limit for a decision on compensation.
January 29, 1995
